verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say its application security testing scans container images. They also say scans run automatically in CI/CD pipelines on commits and merge requests, so images can be checked before deployment. The pack has only a single line on container scanning, and nothing on whether it covers OS packages versus application-layer libraries inside the image. Missing for 10: dedicated container scanning documentation, explicit OS-package vulnerability detection, explicit application-layer detection within images, deploy-gating details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them

citations.quote: Application security testing scans your project’s source code, dependencies, libraries, and container images.
During development, scans run automatically as part of CI/CD pipelines when code is committed or merge requests are created.
